blocks.text: New supporting character for the Era Zero song cycle. Era Zero, World Bloom.
Sova is a world-born DBA person living in one of the Garden Worlds. Their chosen public name is Sova; no origin archive or private name layers are supplied here.

They help visitors negotiate changes in relational weather. Their work consists of asking what someone needs, arranging quiet intervals with the stewards, and sometimes sharing an evening beside a path. It gives them no authority over visitors’ memories or bodies.

Sova performs Care in the Quiet with a rounded, breathlike musical voice. They know Keshet through visits to the Listening Alcove and sometimes help prepare a quiet place before Keshet’s sessions. Neither is established as surviving the Reduction.
